name: Event-Horizon Coupler
coreTradeoff: Attacks compact the horde around their geometry

discoverySentence.text: Every weapon pulls enemies into its attacks, and enemies clustered together take 50% more weapon damage.

trigger.condition: pull applies on every damaging weapon hit; clustered-damage bonus applies while an enemy is within the displayed clustering distance of at least one other living enemy

acquisition.method: found in a relic cache through map exploration
acquisition.cacheOpening: automatic on mech contact; freezes the complete gameplay simulation
acquisition.resolution: immediate install-or-sell; no relic inventory or deferred decision

rarityAndWeighting.selectionModel: three distinct relics drawn without replacement from the currently unlocked pool and assigned to the three caches during generation

stackingAndExclusivity.modifierOrder: Relic-specific multipliers apply after the additive percentage modifiers supplied by mech traits, utilities, and PowerUps unless the relic explicitly replaces targeting or cadence.

behaviorRegistration.hook: per-hit pull and clustered target multiplier
behaviorRegistration.registrationModel: Relics are cross-cutting policies registered by stable relic ID. They modify well-defined hook points rather than scattering ID checks through every weapon.
behaviorRegistration.perWeaponCompatibilityManifest: produced from tests; states fully affected, partially affected with disclosed reason, or invalid. The initial design expects no invalid pairing.

rules.text: Every damaging weapon hit applies an inward displacement toward the nearest meaningful centerline, impact point, field center, projectile path, or other visible center of that attack's geometry.
Existing weapon-authored knockback reverses into pull instead of applying both directions. Non-displacement control such as slow or stun remains unchanged.
An enemy within the displayed clustering distance of at least one other living enemy takes 50% more weapon damage.
Pull resistance continues to scale for elites and bosses, but the clustered-damage rule applies whenever their spatial condition is satisfied.
The relic makes piercing, area, and persistent attacks exceptionally effective while intentionally compacting pursuers into more dangerous concentrations.

crossDocumentRules.rule: Apply target-state multipliers such as Barysteel resonance or Event-Horizon clustering.
crossDocumentRules.meaning: clustered-damage bonus resolves at step 3 of the enemy/rock damage pipeline, after source-side relic reductions or amplification
